## Discovery & Translational Science

- **Quality defects and image alterations plague commercial antibody market** [Science](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/crappy-antibodies-made-superficially-more-appealing)
  - Large-scale evaluations show approximately 50% of commercial antibodies fail in standard applications for which they are marketed, leading to widespread publication of non-reproducible research.
  - Ongoing reports highlight duplicate catalog items cross-sold under different names, supplier quality control issues, and altered Western blot images.

- **Oligodendrocyte pathology identified as driver of cognitive aging** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04630-0)
  - Analysis of human brain tissue across the lifespan links worsening cognitive decline with structural myelin defects produced by dysfunctional oligodendrocytes.
  - Experimental modeling confirmed that age-associated myelin pathology directly impairs cognitive performance.

- **Long-read nanopore sequencing resolves compound oncogenic mutations** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.05.05.26351600)
  - Long-read haplotype phasing successfully determined allele configuration (cis vs. trans) in 69.6% of cryptic cancer cases where short-read sequencing was ambiguous.
  - Confirmed trans configurations for biallelic tumor suppressor loss and identified recurrent compound cis oncogenic mutations across *NOTCH1*, *PIK3CA*, and *PDGFRB*.

- **Macrophage-derived VEGFA maintains intraocular pressure homeostasis in aging** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.20.746006)
  - Single-cell RNA sequencing and tissue imaging revealed age-dependent accumulation of peri-Schlemm's canal macrophages that regulate aqueous humor outflow facility via VEGFA–VEGFR signaling.
  - Conditional deletion of *Vegfa* in CX3CR1⁺ macrophages reduced outflow facility and elevated intraocular pressure in mice.

- **HDAC6 inhibition attenuates endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition in venous thrombosis** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.27.747544)
  - Pharmacological inhibition of HDAC6 using TCS20b suppressed TGFβ- and thrombin-induced endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition in vascular endothelial cells.

- **Solute carrier transporters as therapeutic targets in CNS disease** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41573-026-01513-4)
  - Review synthesizes the roles of solute carrier membrane transporters in maintaining CNS homeostasis and evaluates clinical strategies targeting dysregulation in neurodegenerative disorders, autism, and epilepsy.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **[Biotech]** **Alumis TYK2 inhibitor fails Phase 2 lupus trial** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/alumis-lupus-tyk2-inhibitor-lumus-study-failure/829286/)
  - Oral TYK2 inhibitor envudeucitinib missed primary and key secondary endpoints across the overall study population in a Phase 2 trial for systemic lupus erythematosus.
  - A clinical signal in a patient subgroup exhibiting a high interferon gene signature has prompted Alumis to seek regulatory meetings regarding potential Phase 3 advancement.

- **Lymphodepletion prevents anti-CAR immunity in pediatric brain tumor trial** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.27.26361261)
  - Phase 1 trial of weekly intracerebroventricular IL13BBz-CAR T cells in pediatric and young adult patients with refractory brain tumors met safety objectives, with 8 of 16 evaluable patients demonstrating radiographic tumor reductions.
  - Patients treated without lymphodepletion generated systemic and CSF anti-CAR humoral and cellular responses, whereas lymphodepleted patients showed complete absence of CSF anti-CAR immunity.

- **[Big Pharma]** **DESTINY-Lung06 evaluates trastuzumab deruxtecan and pembrolizumab in 1L NSCLC** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42682104/)
  - First-line trial evaluated the antibody-drug conjugate trastuzumab deruxtecan alongside pembrolizumab in HER2-overexpressing non-small cell lung cancer with PD-L1 TPS <50%.

- **[Biotech]** **Invivyd nears readout for VYD2311 studies** [@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2094757080783630450)
  - Unconfirmed reports indicate that Invivyd's DECLARATION and LIBERTY clinical trials for VYD2311 are approaching completion, with data updates expected in coming weeks.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **[Big Pharma]** **Novartis BTK inhibitor remibrutinib hits endpoints in twin Phase 3 MS trials** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/novartis-remibrutinib-relapsing-multiple-sclerosis-study-results/829300/)
  - Oral BTK inhibitor remibrutinib demonstrated superiority over Aubagio (teriflunomide) in reducing annualized relapse rates and inflammatory brain lesions in two Phase 3 trials for relapsing multiple sclerosis.
  - Treatment showed clinically meaningful impacts on disability progression without hepatotoxicity, a safety concern that has affected rival BTK inhibitors in autoimmune indications.

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **FDA proposes draft regulatory framework for AI in drug development** [FDA Press Release](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-proposes-framework-advance-credibility-ai-models-used-drug-and-biological-product-submissions)
  - Issued first draft guidance establishing a risk-based framework to assess the credibility of artificial intelligence and machine learning models used in drug and biological product regulatory submissions.

- **[Big Pharma]** **FDA mandates Boxed Warning on Injectafer for hypophosphatemia** [FDA Drug Safety Communication](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-communications/fda-adds-boxed-warning-labeling-ferric-carboxymaltose-injection-injectafer-describe-risk-low)
  - Added its most prominent warning to ferric carboxymaltose injection (Injectafer) labeling, warning of severe symptomatic hypophosphatemia risk and advising routine serum phosphate monitoring.

- **FDA cautions against unapproved compounded GLP-1 weight loss drugs** [FDA Statement](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fdas-concerns-unapproved-glp-1-drugs-used-weight-loss)
  - Issued consumer and clinician guidance warning of potential safety, purity, and efficacy risks associated with compounded versions of semaglutide and tirzepatide.

- **[Biotech]** **FDA clears Stryker surgical cockpit with Apple Vision Pro** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/01/fda-stryker-surgical-cockpit-apple-vr-headset-health-tech/)
  - Cleared Stryker's surgical visualization technology integrated with Apple's Vision Pro VR headset for intraoperative applications.

## Business & Strategy

- **[Big Pharma]** **Novartis and BMS pause multiple cell therapy clinical trials** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/09/01/novartis-bristol-trials-paused-pancreatic-cancer-drug-price-pharmalittle-newsletter/)
  - Both Novartis and Bristol Myers Squibb have placed pauses on clinical development activities across several cell therapy programs.

- **Mid-cap biotechs agree to White House Medicaid pricing deals** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/medicaid-low-price-model-drugmakers-white-house/829286/)
  - Drugmakers including Astellas, BridgeBio, CSL, Kyowa Kirin, Sun Pharma, Teva, UCB, Alcon, BeOne, and Incyte entered agreements under CMS's 6-year GENEROUS program to align Medicaid prices with international benchmarks.
  - In exchange, manufacturers received exemptions from Section 232 import tariffs, with several committing to expand U.S. manufacturing footprint.

## Public Health & Policy

- **House stopgap bill blocks White House oversight of NIH research grants** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/01/stopgap-spending-bill-contains-reprieve-nih-research-grant-control/)
  - Federal funding legislation temporarily halts executive branch proposals that would grant political appointees decision-making control over NIH scientific research grant approvals.

**Worth watching:** Detailed liver safety data from Novartis's Phase 3 remibrutinib trials will be critical to watch at upcoming medical congresses, as a clean hepatic profile could differentiate it from competing BTK inhibitors stalled by toxicity issues.
